overview.headline: Secret convention that created a new American government

keyPoints.point: Students learn that the signed document established the government of the United States.
keyPoints.quote: signed on September 17, 1787, established the government of the United States.

keyPoints.point: Students learn the convention convened in Philadelphia to revise the Articles of Confederation.
keyPoints.quote: to revise the Articles of Confederation.

keyPoints.point: Students learn delegates waited until a quorum of seven states was obtained.
keyPoints.quote: until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25.

keyPoints.point: Students learn debate led to drafting an entirely new frame of government.
keyPoints.quote: the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government.

keyTerms.gloss: Gathering of delegates that drafted the new Constitution in secret sessions
keyTerms.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787,

keyTerms.quote: to revise the Articles of Confederation.

keyTerms.gloss: Minimum number of seven states needed to conduct business
keyTerms.quote: until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25.
